Class PricebookEntrySelector

public inherited sharing class PricebookEntrySelector

Selector class for the PricebookEntry object. Provides centralized SOQL query methods for retrieving pricebook entries. Returns results wrapped in a Result inner class extending QueryResult.

Retrieves active PricebookEntry records for a specific pricebook and set of product Ids, returning the Id, Product2Id, and UnitPrice fields.

Parameters:
    pricebookId – The Pricebook2 Id to filter entries by
    productIds – The set of Product2 Ids to match
